package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"

	allocs "example.com/blog/orbit_gen/decl/pages/allocs"
	index "example.com/blog/orbit_gen/decl/pages/index"
	_ "example.com/blog/orbit_gen/impl/components/box"
	_ "example.com/blog/orbit_gen/impl/components/card"
	_ "example.com/blog/orbit_gen/impl/components/frame"
	_ "example.com/blog/orbit_gen/impl/components/tree"
	_ "example.com/blog/orbit_gen/impl/pages/about"
	_ "example.com/blog/orbit_gen/impl/pages/allocs"
	_ "example.com/blog/orbit_gen/impl/pages/index"
	"github.com/orbit-z/orbit"
)

func main() {
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	if err := index.Render(&orbit.Ctx{}, orbit.NewWriter(&buf), index.Props{}, orbit.Slots{}); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if err := allocs.Render(&orbit.Ctx{}, orbit.NewWriter(&buf), allocs.Props{}, orbit.Slots{}); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Print(buf.String())
}
